limits: The three original JOBDNGNICNC method windows have valid instruction-aligned class pointer checks, but owning methods do not establish the referenced class identity.
Both native runtime class slots lie in an unbacked .data portion in the original client EXE. This is a static file finding, not proof about their values after runtime class metadata initialization.
Direct RIP-relative 64-bit MOV register-to-memory patterns found no source-native writer to either slot; indirect table-driven initialization and other write opcode families are not excluded.
The static original native caller checks at +0xC5 and class ancestor arrays at +0x30 cannot be transformed into a semantic Scene/Point/chest type without original concrete class initialization.
Original Scene/Point asset loader, full record EOF, chest placement, level and client/server ownership remain unknown.
